name: AK820 Pro Sentinel
author: imanubdesigner
description: Prevents the Ajazz AK820 Pro from disconnecting on Linux: a read only HID watchdog for the 2.4 GHz receiver, with a status panel in the Omarchy theme.

barWidget.description: Shield icon tinted by receiver state, with a panel listing HID interfaces, recovery attempts, last event and uptime.
